final_prompt: Use case: infographic-diagram. Asset type: wide cover infographic illustration for a Chinese technology blog article, aspect ratio 2.35:1. Primary request: create a clear conceptual cover explaining why .NET 11 Runtime Async can reduce async overhead. Theme: preserve original async control flow, let synchronously completed work return directly, and save continuation state only when a real suspension occurs. Summary angle: one chibi async courier carries a luminous result capsule through a connected journey; the old path begins with heavy state-machine luggage, the completed-task path becomes a direct express lane, and the waiting path creates a small continuation backpack only at the red signal. Narrative flow: conflict-to-resolution. Information blocks: first, the courier struggles beside compact stacked gear-box luggage with the approved label exactly '状态机'; second, a green completed-task gate opens onto a short direct lane and the approved label exactly '直达'; third, a red waiting gate causes the courier to pick up one small resume backpack, with the approved label exactly '挂起'. Main metaphor: an async courier passing two task gates, paying only for the path actually used. Primary subject: one chibi courier holding one luminous result capsule. Composition: ultra-wide left-to-right continuous motion, three connected beats without separate comic panels, courier and capsule remain the only dominant focus, ample negative space, bold readable arrows, clear at thumbnail size. Style/medium: combine abstract technical concept art with chibi character illustration, small cute proportions, simplified expressions, playful shapes, clear infographic readability. Use deep navy, warm white, bright teal-green, and small orange-red accents. Visible text policy: render only '状态机', '直达', and '挂起'; no title, sentences, English words, model names, formulas, numbers, extra labels, fake UI, watermark, or prompt residue. Constraints: exactly one courier and one dominant result capsule, three supporting narrative beats, no product logos, no screenshots, no fake benchmark charts, no fake terminal output, no fabricated metrics, no unrelated icon collage. Avoid generic robots, code rain, neon city backgrounds, giant HUD overlays, dense code, excessive characters, complex multi-panel comics, decorative clutter, and illegible microtext.
